description: Returns, for a US city and state or ZIP code (point checks such as the flood zone are for the area's center, not one home): flood zone, FEMA National Risk Index ratings, National Weather Service alerts, air quality, crime rate, drinking water, internet providers, electricity price, home-price trends, EV chargers, county health, childcare prices and nearby HUD housing counselors. A point outside the US returns earthquakes, GDACS disaster alerts within 500 km and the 10-day weather risk. Optional parts, when those inputs are present: a US national park (alerts, closures, fees, campgrounds); night sky at an area's center (aurora chance, moon, darkness, tides); public schools nearby (not school assignment or test scores); a US college (net price after aid, graduation rate, debt, earnings, and a major when supplied). compare_to sets a second US city or ZIP code beside the first and lists the numbers that differ. Applies to questions about conditions and services in a US city or ZIP code, a national park, the night sky, nearby schools or a US college. Results report what the official sources say and are not a safety assessment or an insurance quote.

college.description: A US college's name, e.g. 'University of Washington', 'Rice University'

compare_to.description: A second US city and state or ZIP code, to set next to `location` and list the numbers that differ. Not a ranking.

location.description: A US city and state or a ZIP code, e.g. 'Austin, TX' or '78701'.

major.description: A field of study at the college, for what its graduates earn and borrow, e.g. 'nursing'

park.description: A US national park or site's name or 4-letter NPS code, e.g. 'Yosemite', 'mora'

place.description: Name of the place, for the answer

schools.description: true for public schools near the area center, closest first

sky.description: true for the night sky at the point: aurora chance, moon, darkness and, on US coasts, tides

state.description: Two-letter state to narrow a common college name, e.g. 'WA'

name: check_place
title: Place: hazards, weather, schools, parks and the night sky
